notes: New look "Clean 4-Word": plain white text, at most four words per line, with a one-click smooth slide-up animation switch.
New look "Soft Editorial": centred light-sans lines, key words in serif caps / bold glow / bold inline / warm bold / gold glow / serif italic, letter-by-letter reveals.
Caption looks gallery (section 4): change the whole style in one click; save your own looks.
Per-word and key-word styling: any installed font, solid or gradient fill, outline and glow, for one word or every occurrence.
Updates: check for new versions and new looks from inside the app (opt-in).
Fixes: fill colour hidden by a gradient, layout-specific overrides ignoring "all layouts" edits, After Effects reports for relative project folders.
